  HARDENING_SUGGESTION: `text=True` decodes `git show` stdout using the process locale encoding. JSON requires UTF-8 by spec, but a non-UTF-8 locale (LANG=C / POSIX) would raise UnicodeDecodeError on any non-ASCII bytes. The current handler catches it (returns None), so the verdict stays safe, but the failure mode relies on the locale rather than on the wire format.
  Suggested minimal fix: pass `encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"` so settings.json is always decoded as UTF-8 and the existing `except ValueError` still catches truly malformed content. One-arg change.
